_comment: Remove this _comment key before writing to production.
Handler types: command | http | mcp_tool | prompt | agent
Use 'exit 2' in shell scripts to block the associated action.
Set timeout explicitly — default 600s is too long for most hooks.

PreToolUse._comment: Fires before every Bash tool call. Use 'if' to narrow further.

hooks._comment_if: Only spawn process when the tool input matches this pattern

PostToolUse._comment: Fires after any file-writing tool. Good for linting or formatting.

Stop._comment: Fires when Claude Code stops. Use async:true for background work.
